sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Rose Gold-Plated AD Stone Band Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Shine with elegance in this Rose gold-plated adjustable band ring, featuring a sleek double row of sparkling American Diamond stones. Designed for comfort and style, it's the perfect choice for daily wear, party looks, and thoughtful gifting.
- Material: Brass base
- Plating: Premium Gold-plated finish
- Stone Type: American Diamond (AD) stones
- Design: Double-row band with stone detailing
- Size & Fit: Adjustable – fits most finger sizes
- Style & Use: Perfect for daily wear, parties, and gifting
